summary: Iteration-19 regression verification of the code-review cleanup (logger util, ROLES_* constants in App.js, useCallback stabilisation of Vendors.js/Sites.js loaders, env-driven ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend tests). All 42 targeted pytest cases pass (test_storage_upload, test_ai_photos_and_agreement, test_seed_admin_password, test_ai_photo_spend, test_onboarding_menu). Env-override proven: exporting ADMIN_PASSWORD=wrongpw causes /api/auth/login to return 401 during pytest setup, confirming the credentials are read from env. Frontend smoke as master admin: /master/dashboard, /master/vendors, /master/sites all load with zero console errors; Sites delete buttons present (4 sites); AI-photo-spend card and iteration-18 features still render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: logger.js is a good dev/prod switch, but if it is only a thin wrapper around console.* it could still leak PII in dev consoles shared over screen-share; consider redacting emails/ids before logging.

App.js ROLES_ANY duplicates the union of the other role arrays; a single derived constant (e.g. Array.from(new Set([...ROLES_EMPLOYEE, ...ROLES_VENDOR, ...])) ) would keep them in sync automatically if a new role is ever added.
